title: The AIX system must have no .netrc files on the system.
check_content:
Check the system for the existence of any ".netrc" files by running the following command: 
# find / -name .netrc 

If any ".netrc" file exists, this is a finding.
VulnDiscussion: Unencrypted passwords for remote FTP servers may be stored in .netrc files. Policy requires passwords be encrypted in storage and not used in access scripts.
